description: Online reversing helpers: compare decompilers, match source to asm, assemble/disassemble.

tools.name: Decompiler Explorer (dogbolt)
tools.desc: Upload a binary, run Ghidra/Hex-Rays/angr/BinaryNinja/RetDec at once and diff the output

tools.name: Compiler Explorer (godbolt)
tools.desc: Compile C/C++/Rust/Go to asm live: match a source construct to the instructions it emits

tools.name: defuse.ca asm/disasm
tools.desc: Assemble or disassemble x86/x64 bytes in the browser, fast sanity check on a few bytes
